{{Quote|She died when I was young. I don't remember her.|Risha Drayen|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Human female''' lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nok Drayen]], with whom she had a daughter named [[Risha Drayen|Risha]]. She died before Risha was old enough to have any recollections of her. Drayen incorrectly suspected the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Braden]] of having an affair with his wife, prompting Braden to flee to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] space.
